title: Lamina Labs Simi: video generation explainers
excerpt: Today, we're introducing ChatGPT for Explainer Videos. With just one prompt, Simi lets you generate whiteboard-style explainer videos
analysis: The post opens with an input to output line. That label comes from the post text, not from watching the video.
